posts.text: ADHD turns curiosity into creativity—and chaos into opportunity.
I’ve learned that ADHD doesn’t need discipline — it needs dopamine.
With ADHD makes me build systems for systems but hey, it keeps life interesting.
ADHD will have you feeling like you’re falling behind
ADHD isn’t failure—it’s misunderstood effort. Drop a 🧠 if you get this.
I built my digital planner after realizing: Every “normal” one made me feel like a failure. So I made one that forgives missed days — and still works.
